description: Default capabilities for the rustllama main window. Permits the core IPC primitives the webview needs to boot, plus the `server_url` custom command exposed by `app/src-tauri/src/main.rs`. Network access goes through plain `fetch` against `http://127.0.0.1:11434` — that's already allowed by the CSP in `tauri.conf.json` and doesn't need a Tauri permission.
